name: Sorrento
tagline: Clifftop lemon town and gateway to Capri and Pompeii
summary: Sorrento sits on cliffs above the Bay of Naples, with lemon groves, a fishing harbour and ferries everywhere. Use it as a base for Capri, Pompeii and the Amalfi Coast, eat gnocchi alla sorrentina, and end the day with limoncello watching Vesuvius at sunset.
seasonNote: May, June and September are ideal; July and August are hot and crowded.
arrival: Naples Airport is about an hour away by bus; the Circumvesuviana train runs from Naples.
gettingAround: Walk the town; ferries to Capri and Amalfi, buses along the coast.
cashTip: Cards work almost everywhere; carry a few euros for coffee bars, tips and small shops.
foodTip: Gnocchi alla sorrentina, fresh seafood, limoncello and delizia al limone.
buyTip: Limoncello, inlaid woodwork and lemon soaps.

connections.note: Circumvesuviana, or fast ferry in 40 minutes.
